16 # Acyclic graphs and trees
17 
18 This module introduces *acyclic graphs* (a.k.a. *forests*) and *trees*.
19 
20 ## Main definitions
21 
22 * `SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic` is a predicate for a graph having no cyclic walks.
23 * `SimpleGraph.IsTree` is a predicate for a graph being a tree (a connected acyclic graph).
24 
25 ## Main statements
26 
27 * `SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_path_unique` characterizes acyclicity in terms of uniqueness of
28   paths between pairs of vertices.
29 * `SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_edge_isBridge` characterizes acyclicity in terms of every
30   edge being a bridge edge.
31 * `SimpleGraph.isTree_iff_existsUnique_path` characterizes trees in terms of existence and
32   uniqueness of paths between pairs of vertices from a nonempty vertex type.
33 
34 ## References
35 
36 The structure of the proofs for `SimpleGraph.IsAcyclic` and `SimpleGraph.IsTree`, including
37 supporting lemmas about `SimpleGraph.IsBridge`, generally follows the high-level description
38 for these theorems for multigraphs from [Chou1994].
39 
40 ## Tags
41 
42 acyclic graphs, trees
43 -/

54 /-- A graph is *acyclic* (or a *forest*) if it has no cycles. -/
55 def IsAcyclic : Prop := ∀ ⦃v : V⦄ (c : G.Walk v v), ¬c.IsCycle
56 
57 /-- A *tree* is a connected acyclic graph. -/
58 @[mk_iff]
59 structure IsTree : Prop extends
60   connected : G.Connected where
61   /-- A tree is acyclic. -/
62   isAcyclic : G.IsAcyclic
63 
64 @[deprecated (since := "2026-03-18")] alias IsTree.isConnected := IsTree.connected
65 @[deprecated (since := "2026-03-18")] alias IsTree.IsAcyclic := IsTree.isAcyclic

69 @[simp] lemma isAcyclic_bot : IsAcyclic (⊥ : SimpleGraph V) := fun _a _w hw ↦ hw.ne_bot rfl

71 /-- A graph that has an injective homomorphism to an acyclic graph is acyclic. -/
72 lemma IsAcyclic.comap (f : G →g G') (hinj : Function.Injective f) (h : G'.IsAcyclic) :
73     G.IsAcyclic :=
74   fun _ _ ↦ map_isCycle_iff_of_injective hinj |>.not.mp <| h _
75 
76 lemma IsAcyclic.embedding (f : G ↪g G') (h : G'.IsAcyclic) : G.IsAcyclic :=
77   h.comap f f.injective
78 
79 /-- Isomorphic graphs are acyclic together. -/
80 lemma Iso.isAcyclic_iff (f : G ≃g G') : G.IsAcyclic ↔ G'.IsAcyclic :=
81   ⟨fun h ↦ h.embedding f.symm, fun h ↦ h.embedding f⟩
82 
83 /-- Isomorphic graphs are trees together. -/
84 lemma Iso.isTree_iff (f : G ≃g G') : G.IsTree ↔ G'.IsTree :=
85   ⟨fun ⟨hc, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨f.connected_iff.mp hc, f.isAcyclic_iff.mp ha⟩,
86    fun ⟨hc, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨f.connected_iff.mpr hc, f.isAcyclic_iff.mpr ha⟩⟩
87 
88 lemma IsAcyclic.of_map (f : V ↪ V') (h : G.map f |>.IsAcyclic) : G.IsAcyclic :=
89   h.embedding <| SimpleGraph.Embedding.map ..
90 
91 lemma IsAcyclic.of_comap (f : V' ↪ V) (h : G.IsAcyclic) : G.comap f |>.IsAcyclic :=
92   h.embedding <| SimpleGraph.Embedding.comap ..

94 /-- A graph induced from an acyclic graph is acyclic. -/
95 lemma IsAcyclic.induce (h : G.IsAcyclic) (s : Set V) : G.induce s |>.IsAcyclic :=
96   h.of_comap _

98 /-- A subgraph of an acyclic graph is acyclic. -/
99 lemma IsAcyclic.subgraph (h : G.IsAcyclic) (H : G.Subgraph) : H.coe.IsAcyclic :=
100   h.comap _ H.hom_injective

102 /-- A spanning subgraph of an acyclic graph is acyclic. -/
103 lemma IsAcyclic.anti {G' : SimpleGraph V} (hsub : G ≤ G') (h : G'.IsAcyclic) : G.IsAcyclic :=
104   h.comap ⟨_, fun h ↦ hsub h⟩ Function.injective_id

106 private lemma Walk.exists_mem_contains_edges_of_directed (Hs : Set <| SimpleGraph V)
107     (hHs : Hs.Nonempty) (h_dir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) Hs) {u v : V} (p : (sSup Hs).Walk u v) :
108     ∃ H ∈ Hs, ∀ e ∈ p.edges, e ∈ H.edgeSet := by
109   induction p with
110   | nil => exact ⟨hHs.some, hHs.some_mem, by simp⟩
111   | @cons u v w h_adj p ih =>
112     obtain ⟨H₁, hH₁, ih⟩ := ih
113     obtain ⟨H₂, hH₂, h_adj⟩ : ∃ H₂ ∈ Hs, H₂.Adj u v := h_adj
114     obtain ⟨H, hH, h₁, h₂⟩ := h_dir H₁ hH₁ H₂ hH₂
115     simpa using ⟨H, hH, (le_iff_adj.mp h₂) _ _ h_adj, fun a ha => edgeSet_mono h₁ (ih a ha)⟩
116 
117 /-- The directed supremum of acyclic graphs is acylic. -/
118 lemma isAcyclic_sSup_of_isAcyclic_directedOn (Hs : Set <| SimpleGraph V)
119     (h_acyc : ∀ H ∈ Hs, H.IsAcyclic) (h_dir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) Hs) : IsAcyclic (sSup Hs) := by
120   rcases Hs.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hnemp
121   · simp
122   · intro u p hp
123     obtain ⟨H, hH, hpH⟩ := p.exists_mem_contains_edges_of_directed Hs hnemp h_dir
124     exact h_acyc H hH (p.transfer H hpH) <| Walk.IsCycle.transfer hp hpH

126 /-- Every acyclic subgraph `H ≤ G` is contained in a maximal such subgraph. -/
127 theorem exists_maximal_isAcyclic_of_le_isAcyclic
128     {H : SimpleGraph V} (hHG : H ≤ G) (hH : H.IsAcyclic) :
129     ∃ H' : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ H' ∧ Maximal (fun H => H ≤ G ∧ H.IsAcyclic) H' := by
130   refine zorn_le_nonempty₀ {H | H ≤ G ∧ H.IsAcyclic} (fun c hcs hc y hy ↦ ?_) _ ⟨hHG, hH⟩
131   refine ⟨sSup c, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun _ ↦ le_sSup⟩
132   · grind [sSup_le_iff]
133   · exact isAcyclic_sSup_of_isAcyclic_directedOn c (by grind) hc.directedOn

167 theorem isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge :
168     G.IsAcyclic ↔ ∀ ⦃v w : V⦄, G.Adj v w → G.IsBridge s(v, w) := by
169   simp_rw [isBridge_iff_adj_and_forall_cycle_notMem]
170   constructor
171   · intro ha v w hvw
172     apply And.intro hvw
173     intro u p hp
174     cases ha p hp
175   · rintro hb v (_ | ⟨ha, p⟩) hp
176     · exact hp.not_of_nil
177     · apply (hb ha).2 _ hp
178       rw [Walk.edges_cons]
179       apply List.mem_cons_self
180 
181 theorem isAcyclic_iff_forall_edge_isBridge :
182     G.IsAcyclic ↔ ∀ ⦃e⦄, e ∈ (G.edgeSet) → G.IsBridge e := by
183   simp [isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge, Sym2.forall]

185 theorem IsAcyclic.path_unique {G : SimpleGraph V} (h : G.IsAcyclic) {v w : V} (p q : G.Path v w) :
186     p = q := by
187   obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := p
188   obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := q
189   rw [Subtype.mk.injEq]
190   induction p with
191   | nil =>
192     cases (Walk.isPath_iff_eq_nil _).mp hq
193     rfl
194   | cons ph p ih =>
195     rw [isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge] at h
196     specialize h ph
197     rw [isBridge_iff_adj_and_forall_walk_mem_edges] at h
198     replace h := h.2 (q.append p.reverse)
199     simp only [Walk.edges_append, Walk.edges_reverse, List.mem_append, List.mem_reverse] at h
200     rcases h with h | h
201     · cases q with
202       | nil => simp at hp
203       | cons _ q =>
204         rw [Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at hp hq
205         simp only [Walk.edges_cons, List.mem_cons, Sym2.eq_iff, true_and] at h
206         rcases h with (⟨h, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) | h
207         · cases ih hp.1 q hq.1
208           rfl
209         · simp at hq
210         · exact absurd (Walk.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges _ h) hq.2
211     · rw [Walk.cons_isPath_iff] at hp
212       exact absurd (Walk.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges _ h) hp.2
213 
214 theorem isAcyclic_of_path_unique (h : ∀ (v w : V) (p q : G.Path v w), p = q) : G.IsAcyclic := by
215   intro v c hc
216   simp only [Walk.isCycle_def, Ne] at hc
217   cases c with
218   | nil => cases hc.2.1 rfl
219   | cons ha c' =>
220     simp only [Walk.isTrail_cons, Walk.support_cons, List.tail_cons] at hc
221     specialize h _ _ ⟨c', by simp only [Walk.isPath_def, hc.2]⟩ (Path.singleton ha.symm)
222     rw [Path.singleton, Subtype.mk.injEq] at h
223     simp [h] at hc
224 
225 theorem isAcyclic_iff_path_unique : G.IsAcyclic ↔ ∀ ⦃v w : V⦄ (p q : G.Path v w), p = q :=
226   ⟨IsAcyclic.path_unique, isAcyclic_of_path_unique⟩

228 lemma IsAcyclic.mem_support_of_ne_mem_support_of_adj_of_isPath (hG : G.IsAcyclic) {u v w : V}
229     {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk u w} (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath) (hadj : G.Adj v w)
230     (hv : v ∉ q.support) : w ∈ p.support := by
231   rw [Subtype.mk.inj <| isAcyclic_iff_path_unique.mp hG ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨_, hq.concat hv hadj.symm⟩]
232   exact q.support_subset_support_concat _ q.end_mem_support
233 
234 lemma IsAcyclic.ne_mem_support_of_support_of_adj_of_isPath (hG : G.IsAcyclic) {u v w : V}
235     {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk u w} (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath) (hadj : G.Adj v w)
236     (hw : w ∈ p.support) : v ∉ q.support := by
237   obtain ⟨p₀, p₁, hp₀, hp₁, happend⟩ := hp.mem_support_iff_exists_append.mp hw
238   rw [← Subtype.mk.inj <| hG.path_unique ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩]
239   exact fun hxp => (happend ▸ hp).ne_of_mem_support_of_append hadj.symm.ne' hxp
240     (p₁.end_mem_support) rfl
241 
242 lemma IsAcyclic.path_concat (hG : G.IsAcyclic) {u v w : V} {p : G.Walk u v} {q : G.Walk u w}
243     (hp : p.IsPath) (hq : q.IsPath) (hadj : G.Adj v w) (hv : v ∈ q.support) :
244     q = p.concat hadj := by
245   have hw : w ∉ p.support := hG.ne_mem_support_of_support_of_adj_of_isPath hq hp hadj.symm hv
246   exact Subtype.mk.inj <| isAcyclic_iff_path_unique.mp hG ⟨q, hq⟩ ⟨_, hp.concat hw hadj⟩
247 
248 theorem isTree_iff_existsUnique_path :
249     G.IsTree ↔ Nonempty V ∧ ∀ v w : V, ∃! p : G.Walk v w, p.IsPath := by
250   classical
251   rw [isTree_iff, isAcyclic_iff_path_unique]
252   constructor
253   · rintro ⟨hc, hu⟩
254     refine ⟨hc.nonempty, ?_⟩
255     intro v w
256     let q := (hc v w).some.toPath
257     use q
258     simp only [true_and, Path.isPath]
259     intro p hp
260     specialize hu ⟨p, hp⟩ q
261     exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hu
262   · rintro ⟨hV, h⟩
263     refine ⟨Connected.mk ?_, ?_⟩
264     · intro v w
265       obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := h v w
266       exact p.reachable
267     · rintro v w ⟨p, hp⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩
268       simp only [ExistsUnique.unique (h v w) hp hq]
269 
270 lemma IsTree.existsUnique_path (hG : G.IsTree) : ∀ v w, ∃! p : G.Walk v w, p.IsPath :=
271   (isTree_iff_existsUnique_path.1 hG).2
272 
273 theorem IsAcyclic.isPath_iff_isChain (hG : G.IsAcyclic) {v w : V} (p : G.Walk v w) :
274      p.IsPath ↔ List.IsChain (· ≠ ·) p.edges := by
275   classical
276   refine ⟨fun h ↦ (edges_nodup_of_support_nodup <| p.isPath_def.mp h).isChain, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
277   induction p with
278   | nil => simp
279   | @cons u' v' _ head tail ih =>
280     have hcc := List.isChain_cons.mp (edges_cons _ _ ▸ h)
281     refine cons_isPath_iff head tail |>.mpr ⟨ih hcc.2, ?_⟩
282     rcases tail.length.eq_zero_or_pos with h' | h'
283     · simp [nil_iff_support_eq.mp (nil_iff_length_eq.mpr h'), head.ne]
284     · by_contra hh
285       apply hG <| cons head (tail.takeUntil u' hh)
286       simp only [isCycle_def, isTrail_def, edges_cons, List.nodup_cons, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq,
287         not_false_eq_true, support_cons, List.tail_cons, true_and]
288       have : cons head (tail.takeUntil u' hh) |>.support.tail.Nodup :=
289         tail.isPath_def.mp (ih hcc.2) |>.sublist <| List.IsInfix.sublist
290           ⟨[], (tail.dropUntil u' hh).support.tail, by simp [← support_append]⟩
291       refine ⟨⟨?_, edges_nodup_of_support_nodup this⟩, this⟩
292       by_contra hhh
293       refine hcc.1 s(u', v') ?_ rfl
294       rw [← tail.cons_tail_eq (by simp [not_nil_iff_lt_length, h'])]
295       have := IsPath.mk' this |>.eq_snd_of_mem_edges (Sym2.eq_swap ▸ hhh)
296       simp [this, snd_takeUntil head.ne]
297 
298 theorem IsAcyclic.isPath_iff_isTrail (hG : G.IsAcyclic) {v w : V} (p : G.Walk v w) :
299     p.IsPath ↔ p.IsTrail :=
300   ⟨IsPath.isTrail, fun h ↦ hG.isPath_iff_isChain p |>.mpr <| p.isTrail_def.mp h |>.isChain⟩
301 
302 lemma IsTree.card_edgeFinset [Fintype V] [Fintype G.edgeSet] (hG : G.IsTree) :
303     Finset.card G.edgeFinset + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
304   have := hG.connected.nonempty
305   inhabit V
306   classical
307   have : Finset.card ({default} : Finset V)ᶜ + 1 = Fintype.card V := by
308     rw [Finset.card_compl, Finset.card_singleton, Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos]
309   rw [← this, add_left_inj]
310   choose f hf hf' using (hG.existsUnique_path · default)
311   refine Eq.symm <| Finset.card_bij
312           (fun w hw => ((f w).firstDart <| ?notNil).edge)
313           (fun a ha => ?memEdges) ?inj ?surj
314   case notNil => exact not_nil_of_ne (by simpa using hw)
315   case memEdges => simp
316   case inj =>
317     intro a ha b hb h
318     wlog h' : (f a).length ≤ (f b).length generalizing a b
319     · exact Eq.symm (this _ hb _ ha h.symm (le_of_not_ge h'))
320     rw [dart_edge_eq_iff] at h
321     obtain (h | h) := h
322     · exact (congrArg (·.fst) h)
323     · have h1 : ((f a).firstDart <| not_nil_of_ne (by simpa using ha)).snd = b :=
324         congrArg (·.snd) h
325       have h3 := congrArg length (hf' _ ((f _).tail.copy h1 rfl) ?_)
326       · rw [length_copy, ← add_left_inj 1,
327           length_tail_add_one (not_nil_of_ne (by simpa using ha))] at h3
328         lia
329       · simp only [isPath_copy]
330         exact (hf _).tail
331   case surj =>
332     simp only [mem_edgeFinset, Finset.mem_compl, Finset.mem_singleton, Sym2.forall, mem_edgeSet]
333     intro x y h
334     wlog h' : (f x).length ≤ (f y).length generalizing x y
335     · rw [Sym2.eq_swap]
336       exact this y x h.symm (le_of_not_ge h')
337     refine ⟨y, ?_, dart_edge_eq_mk'_iff.2 <| Or.inr ?_⟩
338     · rintro rfl
339       rw [← hf' _ nil IsPath.nil, length_nil,
340           ← hf' _ (.cons h .nil) (IsPath.nil.cons <| by simpa using h.ne),
341           length_cons, length_nil] at h'
342       simp at h'
343     rw [← hf' _ (.cons h.symm (f x)) ((cons_isPath_iff _ _).2 ⟨hf _, fun hy => ?contra⟩)]
344     · simp
345     case contra =>
346       suffices (f x).takeUntil y hy = .cons h .nil by
347         rw [← take_spec _ hy] at h'
348         simp [this, hf' _ _ ((hf _).dropUntil hy)] at h'
349       refine (hG.existsUnique_path _ _).unique ((hf _).takeUntil _) ?_
350       simp [h.ne]

352 /-- A minimally connected graph is a tree. -/
353 lemma isTree_of_minimal_connected (h : Minimal Connected G) : IsTree G := by
354   rw [isTree_iff, and_iff_right h.prop, isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge]
355   exact fun _ _ _ ↦ by_contra fun hbr ↦ h.not_prop_of_lt
356     (by simpa [deleteEdges, ← edgeSet_ssubset_edgeSet])
357     <| h.prop.connected_delete_edge_of_not_isBridge hbr
358 
359 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
360 lemma isTree_iff_minimal_connected : IsTree G ↔ Minimal Connected G := by
361   refine ⟨fun htree ↦ ⟨htree.connected, fun G' h' hle u v hadj ↦ ?_⟩, isTree_of_minimal_connected⟩
362   have ⟨p, hp⟩ := h'.exists_isPath u v
363   have := congrArg Walk.edges <| congrArg Subtype.val <|
364     htree.isAcyclic.path_unique ⟨p.mapLe hle, hp.mapLe hle⟩ <| Path.singleton hadj
365   simp only [edges_map, Hom.coe_ofLE, Sym2.map_id, List.map_id_fun, id_eq] at this
366   simp [this, p.adj_of_mem_edges]

368 /-- Connecting two unreachable vertices by an edge preserves acyclicity. -/
369 theorem IsAcyclic.isAcyclic_sup_fromEdgeSet_of_not_reachable {u v : V} (hnreach : ¬G.Reachable u v)
370     (hacyc : G.IsAcyclic) : (G ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(u, v)}).IsAcyclic := by
371   grind [isAcyclic_iff_forall_edge_isBridge, IsBridge.sup_fromEdgeSet_of_not_reachable,
372     edgeSet_sup, IsBridge.sup_fromEdgeSet_of_not_reachable_of_isBridge, edgeSet_fromEdgeSet]
373 
374 theorem isAcyclic_add_edge_iff_of_not_reachable (x y : V) (hxy : ¬ G.Reachable x y) :
375     (G ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(x, y)}).IsAcyclic ↔ IsAcyclic G :=
376   ⟨.anti le_sup_left, .isAcyclic_sup_fromEdgeSet_of_not_reachable hxy⟩
377 
378 /-- Adding an edge results in an acyclic graph iff the original graph was acyclic and
379 the edge connects vertices that previously had no path between them. -/
380 theorem isAcyclic_sup_fromEdgeSet_iff {u v : V} :
381     (G ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(u, v)}).IsAcyclic ↔
382       G.IsAcyclic ∧ (G.Reachable u v → u = v ∨ G.Adj u v) := by
383   by_cases huv : u = v
384   · grind [sup_eq_left, fromEdgeSet_le, Sym2.mem_diagSet, Sym2.mk_isDiag_iff]
385   by_cases hadj : G.Adj u v
386   · grind [sup_eq_left, fromEdgeSet_le, mem_edgeSet]
387   refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨hacyc, hreach⟩ ↦ hacyc.isAcyclic_sup_fromEdgeSet_of_not_reachable <| by grind⟩
388   refine fun hacyc ↦ ⟨hacyc.anti le_sup_left, fun hreach ↦ False.elim ?_⟩
389   have := isAcyclic_iff_forall_edge_isBridge.mp (e := s(u, v)) hacyc <| by simp [huv]
390   refine isBridge_iff.mp this |>.right <| hreach.mono <| Eq.le <| Eq.symm ?_
391   rw [sup_sdiff_right_self]
392   exact deleteEdges_eq_self.mpr <| Set.disjoint_singleton_right.mpr hadj
393 
394 /--
395 The reachability relation of a maximal acyclic subgraph agrees with that of the larger graph.
396 -/
397 lemma reachable_eq_of_maximal_isAcyclic (F : SimpleGraph V)
398     (h : Maximal (fun H ↦ H ≤ G ∧ H.IsAcyclic) F) : F.Reachable = G.Reachable := by
399   ext u v
400   refine ⟨.mono h.prop.left, fun ⟨p⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
401   by_contra
402   let s : F.ConnectedComponent := .mk _ u
403   have : v ∉ s := this ∘ s.reachable_of_mem_supp rfl
404   have : ∃ d ∈ p.darts, d.fst ∈ s ∧ d.snd ∉ s := p.exists_boundary_dart s rfl this
405   rcases this with ⟨⟨⟨u', v'⟩, huv⟩, _, hu, hv⟩
406   have : ¬F.Reachable v' u' := mt ConnectedComponent.sound <| s.mem_supp_iff u' |>.mp hu ▸ hv
407   suffices F ⊔ fromEdgeSet {s(v', u')} ≤ F by
408     grind [Adj.reachable, sup_le_iff, le_iff_adj, fromEdgeSet_adj]
409   refine h.le_of_ge ⟨?_, h.prop.right.isAcyclic_sup_fromEdgeSet_of_not_reachable this⟩ le_sup_left
410   grind [Maximal, sup_le, le_iff_adj, fromEdgeSet_adj, huv.symm]
411 
412 /-- A subgraph is maximal acyclic iff its reachability relation agrees with the larger graph. -/
413 theorem maximal_isAcyclic_iff_reachable_eq {F : SimpleGraph V} (hle : F ≤ G) (hF : F.IsAcyclic) :
414     Maximal (fun F ↦ F ≤ G ∧ F.IsAcyclic) F ↔ F.Reachable = G.Reachable := by
415   refine ⟨reachable_eq_of_maximal_isAcyclic F, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
416   by_contra
417   have ⟨H, hFH, hHG, hH⟩ := exists_gt_of_not_maximal ⟨hle, hF⟩ this
418   have ⟨e, heH, heF⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset <| edgeSet_strict_mono hFH
419   have h_bridge : (F ⊔ fromEdgeSet {e}).IsBridge e := by
420     refine isAcyclic_iff_forall_edge_isBridge.mp ?_ <| by simp [H.not_isDiag_of_mem_edgeSet heH]
421     exact hH.anti <| sup_le_iff.mpr ⟨hFH.le, H.fromEdgeSet_le.mpr <| by grind⟩
422   have : (F ⊔ fromEdgeSet {e}) \ fromEdgeSet {e} = F := by simpa using heF
423   cases e
424   rw [isBridge_iff, this, h] at h_bridge
425   exact h_bridge.right <| hHG heH |>.reachable
426 
427 /-- A subgraph of a connected graph is maximal acyclic iff it is a tree. -/
428 theorem Connected.maximal_le_isAcyclic_iff_isTree {T : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.Connected)
429     (hT : T ≤ G) : Maximal (fun H ↦ H ≤ G ∧ H.IsAcyclic) T ↔ T.IsTree := by
430   have := hG.nonempty
431   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨⟨fun u v ↦ ?_⟩, h.1.2⟩, fun hT' ↦ ?_⟩
432   · exact G.reachable_eq_of_maximal_isAcyclic T h ▸ hG.preconnected u v
433   · rw [maximal_isAcyclic_iff_reachable_eq hT hT'.isAcyclic,
434       T.preconnected_iff_reachable_eq_top.mp hT'.preconnected,
435       G.preconnected_iff_reachable_eq_top.mp hG.preconnected]
436 
437 @[simp]
438 theorem maximal_isAcyclic_iff_isTree [Nonempty V] {T : SimpleGraph V} :
439     Maximal IsAcyclic T ↔ T.IsTree := by
440   simp [← connected_top.maximal_le_isAcyclic_iff_isTree le_top]
441 
442 /-- A maximally acyclic graph is a tree. This is similar to `maximal_isAcyclic_iff_isTree` except
443 with `Nonempty V` as part of the iff rather than an assumption. -/
444 theorem isTree_iff_maximal_isAcyclic : G.IsTree ↔ Nonempty V ∧ Maximal IsAcyclic G := by
445   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨_, h⟩ ↦ G.maximal_isAcyclic_iff_isTree.mp h⟩
446   have := h.nonempty
447   exact ⟨this, G.maximal_isAcyclic_iff_isTree.mpr h⟩
448 
449 /-- Every acyclic subgraph can be extended to a spanning forest. -/
450 theorem exists_isAcyclic_reachable_eq_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic {H : SimpleGraph V} (hH_le : H ≤ G)
451     (hH_isAcyclic : H.IsAcyclic) :
452     ∃ F : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ F ∧ F ≤ G ∧ F.IsAcyclic ∧ F.Reachable = G.Reachable := by
453   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := G.exists_maximal_isAcyclic_of_le_isAcyclic hH_le hH_isAcyclic
454   grind [maximal_isAcyclic_iff_reachable_eq, Maximal]
455 
456 /-- Every graph has a spanning forest. -/
457 theorem exists_isAcyclic_reachable_eq_le :
458     ∃ F ≤ G, F.IsAcyclic ∧ F.Reachable = G.Reachable := by
459   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := G.exists_isAcyclic_reachable_eq_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic bot_le isAcyclic_bot
460   grind
461 
462 /-- Every acyclic subgraph of a connected graph can be extended to a spanning tree. -/
463 lemma Connected.exists_isTree_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic {H : SimpleGraph V} (h : G.Connected)
464     (hH_le : H ≤ G) (hH_isAcyclic : H.IsAcyclic) :
465     ∃ F : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ F ∧ F ≤ G ∧ F.IsTree := by
466   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := G.exists_isAcyclic_reachable_eq_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic hH_le hH_isAcyclic
467   grind [IsTree, Connected, preconnected_iff_reachable_eq_top]
468 
469 /-- Every connected graph has a spanning tree. -/
470 lemma Connected.exists_isTree_le (h : G.Connected) : ∃ T ≤ G, IsTree T := by
471   obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := G.exists_isAcyclic_reachable_eq_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic bot_le isAcyclic_bot
472   grind [IsTree, Connected, preconnected_iff_reachable_eq_top]
473 
474 /-- Every connected graph on `n` vertices has at least `n-1` edges. -/
475 lemma Connected.card_vert_le_card_edgeSet_add_one (h : G.Connected) :
476     Nat.card V ≤ Nat.card G.edgeSet + 1 := by
477   obtain hV | hV := (finite_or_infinite V).symm
478   · simp
479   have := Fintype.ofFinite
480   obtain ⟨T, hle, hT⟩ := h.exists_isTree_le
481   rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← hT.card_edgeFinset, add_le_add_iff_right,
482     Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← edgeFinset_card]
483   exact Finset.card_mono <| by simpa
484 
485 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
486 lemma isTree_iff_connected_and_card [Finite V] :
487     G.IsTree ↔ G.Connected ∧ Nat.card G.edgeSet + 1 = Nat.card V := by
488   have := Fintype.ofFinite V
489   classical
490   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h.connected, by simpa [edgeFinset] using h.card_edgeFinset⟩,
491     fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ ⟨h₁, ?_⟩⟩
492   simp_rw [isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge]
493   refine fun x y h ↦ by_contra fun hbr ↦
494     (h₁.connected_delete_edge_of_not_isBridge hbr).card_vert_le_card_edgeSet_add_one.not_gt ?_
495   rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← edgeFinset_card, ← h₂, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
496     ← edgeFinset_card, add_lt_add_iff_right]
497   exact Finset.card_lt_card <| by simpa [deleteEdges, edgeFinset]
498 
499 /-- The minimum degree of all vertices in a nontrivial tree is one. -/
500 lemma IsTree.minDegree_eq_one_of_nontrivial (h : G.IsTree) [Fintype V] [Nontrivial V]
501     [DecidableRel G.Adj] : G.minDegree = 1 := by
502   by_cases q : 2 ≤ G.minDegree
503   · have := h.card_edgeFinset
504     have := G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges
505     have hle : ∑ v : V, 2 ≤ ∑ v, G.degree v := by
506       gcongr
507       exact le_trans q (G.minDegree_le_degree _)
508     rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, smul_eq_mul] at hle
509     lia
510   · have := h.preconnected.minDegree_pos_of_nontrivial
511     lia
512 
513 /-- A nontrivial tree has a vertex of degree one. -/
514 lemma IsTree.exists_vert_degree_one_of_nontrivial [Fintype V] [Nontrivial V] [DecidableRel G.Adj]
515     (h : G.IsTree) : ∃ v, G.degree v = 1 := by
516   obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := G.exists_minimal_degree_vertex
517   use v
518   rw [← hv]
519   exact h.minDegree_eq_one_of_nontrivial
520 
521 /-- The graph resulting from removing a vertex of degree one from a connected graph is connected. -/
522 lemma Connected.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one (hconn : G.Connected) {v : V}
523     [Fintype ↑(G.neighborSet v)] (hdeg : G.degree v = 1) : (G.induce {v}ᶜ).Connected := by
524   obtain ⟨u, adj_vu, hu⟩ := degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj.mp hdeg
525   refine (connected_iff _).mpr ⟨?_, u, by aesop⟩
526   /- There exists a walk between any two vertices w and x in G.induce {v}ᶜ
527   via the unique vertex u adjacent to vertex v. -/
528   intro w x
529   obtain ⟨pwu, hpwu⟩ := hconn.exists_isPath w u
530   obtain ⟨pux, hpux⟩ := hconn.exists_isPath u x
531   rw [Reachable, ← exists_true_iff_nonempty]
532   classical
533   use ((pwu.append pux).toPath.val.induce {v}ᶜ ?_).copy (SetCoe.ext rfl) (SetCoe.ext rfl)
534   /- Each path between vertex u and another vertex in G.induce {v}ᶜ
535   is contained in G.induce {v}ᶜ. -/
536   intro z hz
537   rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
538   obtain ⟨pwz, pzx, p_eq_pwzx⟩ := mem_support_iff_exists_append.mp hz
539   /- Prove vertex v is not in the path formed from the concatenated walks
540   by showing that vertex u must then be passed twice. -/
541   by_contra
542   subst_vars
543   refine List.nodup_iff_forall_not_duplicate.mp (pwu.append pux).toPath.nodup_support u ?_
544   rw [p_eq_pwzx, support_append, List.duplicate_iff_two_le_count, List.count_append]
545   have := List.one_le_count_iff.mpr (pwz.getVert_mem_support (pwz.length - 1))
546   simp only [hu _ (pwz.adj_penultimate (not_nil_of_ne (by aesop))).symm] at this
547   have := List.one_le_count_iff.mpr (pzx.snd_mem_tail_support (not_nil_of_ne (by aesop)))
548   rw [hu _ (pzx.adj_snd (not_nil_of_ne (by aesop)))] at this
549   lia
550 
551 /-- A finite nontrivial connected graph contains a vertex that leaves the graph connected if
552 removed. -/
553 lemma Connected.exists_connected_induce_compl_singleton_of_finite_nontrivial
554     [Finite V] [Nontrivial V] (hconn : G.Connected) : ∃ v : V, (G.induce {v}ᶜ).Connected := by
555   obtain ⟨T, _, T_isTree⟩ := hconn.exists_isTree_le
556   have ⟨hT, _⟩ := T_isTree
557   have := Fintype.ofFinite V
558   classical
559   obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := T_isTree.exists_vert_degree_one_of_nontrivial
560   exact ⟨v, (hT.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one hv).mono (by tauto)⟩
561 
562 /-- A finite connected graph contains a vertex that leaves the graph preconnected if removed. -/
563 lemma Connected.exists_preconnected_induce_compl_singleton_of_finite [Finite V]
564     (hconn : G.Connected) : ∃ v : V, (G.induce {v}ᶜ).Preconnected := by
565   nontriviality V using hconn.nonempty
566   obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hconn.exists_connected_induce_compl_singleton_of_finite_nontrivial
567   exact ⟨v, hv.preconnected⟩
568 
569 lemma IsAcyclic.dist_ne_of_adj (hG : G.IsAcyclic) {u v w : V} (hadj : G.Adj v w)
570     (hreach : G.Reachable u v) : G.dist u v ≠ G.dist u w := by
571   obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := hreach.exists_path_of_dist
572   obtain ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩ := hreach.trans hadj.reachable |>.exists_path_of_dist
573   rw [← hp', ← hq']
574   by_cases hw : w ∈ p.support
575   · rw [hG.path_concat hq hp hadj.symm hw, q.length_concat]
576     exact q.length.ne_add_one.symm
577   · have hv : v ∈ q.support := hG.mem_support_of_ne_mem_support_of_adj_of_isPath hq hp
578       hadj.symm hw
579     rw [hG.path_concat hp hq hadj hv, p.length_concat]
580     exact p.length.ne_add_one
581 
582 lemma IsTree.dist_ne_of_adj (hG : G.IsTree) (u : V) {v w : V} (hadj : G.Adj v w) :
583     G.dist u v ≠ G.dist u w :=
584   hG.isAcyclic.dist_ne_of_adj hadj <| hG.connected u v
585 
586 lemma IsAcyclic.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj_of_reachable
587     (hG : G.IsAcyclic) (u : V) {v w : V} (hadj : G.Adj v w) (hreach : G.Reachable u v) :
588     G.dist u v = G.dist u w + 1 ∨ G.dist u w = G.dist u v + 1 := by
589   grind [dist_ne_of_adj, Adj.diff_dist_adj]
590 
591 lemma IsTree.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj (hG : G.IsTree) (u : V) {v w : V} (hadj : G.Adj v w) :
592     G.dist u v = G.dist u w + 1 ∨ G.dist u w = G.dist u v + 1 := by
593   grind [dist_ne_of_adj, Adj.diff_dist_adj]

595 /-- The unique two-coloring of a tree that colors the given vertex with zero -/
596 noncomputable def IsTree.coloringTwoOfVert (hG : G.IsTree) (u : V) : G.Coloring (Fin 2) :=
597   Coloring.mk (fun v ↦ ⟨G.dist u v % 2, Nat.mod_lt (G.dist u v) Nat.zero_lt_two⟩) <| by
598     grind [dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj]
599 
600 /-- Arbitrary coloring with two colors for a tree -/
601 noncomputable def IsTree.coloringTwo (hG : G.IsTree) : G.Coloring (Fin 2) :=
602   hG.coloringTwoOfVert hG.connected.nonempty.some
603 
604 lemma IsTree.isBipartite (hG : G.IsTree) : G.IsBipartite :=
605   ⟨hG.coloringTwo⟩
606 
607 /-- The unique two-coloring of a forest that colors the given vertices with zero -/
608 noncomputable def IsAcyclic.coloringTwoOfVerts (hG : G.IsAcyclic) (verts : G.ConnectedComponent → V)
609     (h : ∀ C, verts C ∈ C) : G.Coloring (Fin 2) where
610   toFun v :=
611     let u := verts <| G.connectedComponentMk v
612     ⟨G.dist u v % 2, Nat.mod_lt (G.dist u v) Nat.zero_lt_two⟩
613   map_rel' := by
614     intro u v hadj
615     have := ConnectedComponent.sound hadj.reachable
616     have := hG.dist_eq_dist_add_one_of_adj_of_reachable _ hadj <| ConnectedComponent.exact <| h _
617     grind [top_adj]
618 
619 /-- Arbitrary coloring with two colors for a forest -/
620 noncomputable def IsAcyclic.coloringTwo (hG : G.IsAcyclic) : G.Coloring (Fin 2) :=
621   hG.coloringTwoOfVerts (·.nonempty_supp.some) (·.nonempty_supp.some_mem)
622 
623 lemma IsAcyclic.isBipartite (hG : G.IsAcyclic) : G.IsBipartite :=
624   ⟨hG.coloringTwo⟩
625 
626 /-- An acyclic graph (forest) is 2-colorable. -/
627 lemma IsAcyclic.colorable_two (hG : G.IsAcyclic) : G.Colorable 2 :=
628   hG.isBipartite
629 
630 /-- A tree is 2-colorable. -/
631 lemma IsTree.colorable_two (hG : G.IsTree) : G.Colorable 2 :=
632   hG.isAcyclic.colorable_two
633 
634 /-- The chromatic number of an acyclic graph (forest) is at most 2. -/
635 lemma IsAcyclic.chromaticNumber_le_two (hG : G.IsAcyclic) : G.chromaticNumber ≤ 2 :=
636   hG.colorable_two.chromaticNumber_le
637 
638 /-- The chromatic number of a tree is at most 2. -/
639 lemma IsTree.chromaticNumber_le_two (hG : G.IsTree) : G.chromaticNumber ≤ 2 :=
640   hG.colorable_two.chromaticNumber_le

642 lemma exists_isCycle_of_two_le_isEdgeReachable {u v : V} (huv : u ≠ v) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
643     (h : G.IsEdgeReachable n u v) : ∃ w : G.Walk u u, w.IsCycle := by
644   classical
645   obtain ⟨w, hw, h⟩ := exists_adj_isEdgeReachable_two huv (h.anti hn)
646   have := @h {s(u, w)} (by simp)
647   obtain ⟨w, p, hp₁, hp₂⟩ := adj_and_reachable_delete_edges_iff_exists_cycle.mp ⟨hw, this⟩
648   exact ⟨p.rotate _ (p.fst_mem_support_of_mem_edges hp₂), IsCycle.rotate hp₁ _⟩
649 
650 lemma isAcyclic_iff_pairwise_not_isEdgeReachable_two :
651     G.IsAcyclic ↔ Pairwise (¬G.IsEdgeReachable 2 · ·) := by
652   refine ⟨fun h _ _ hne he ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
653   · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_isCycle_of_two_le_isEdgeReachable hne le_rfl he
654     exact h w hw
655   · refine isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge.mpr fun _ _ hadj ↦ ?_
656     exact isBridge_iff_adj_and_not_isEdgeConnected_two.mpr ⟨hadj, h hadj.ne⟩

658 end SimpleGraph
